name: Myles Lozano
headline: Mechanical and Aerospace engineering student, builder, and problem solver
shortBio: Engineering student at Oklahoma State University passionate about designing innovative solutions and bringing ideas to life through hands-on development.
longBio:
I am a dual-major engineering student at Oklahoma State University studying Aerospace and Mechanical Engineering.

My experience includes internships with Springfield Remanufacturing Company and the OSU New Product Development Center, as well as cofounding TriPoint Innovations LLC. Through these roles, I have worked on product development, engineering design, and early-stage system development.

I will continue this work through my upcoming Summer 2026 internship with GE Aerospace, with a focus on applied engineering and systems-level problem solving.
